notes: No dependency versions changed. Corrected pre-existing lockfile root platform metadata/content hash to match composer.json; package records unchanged.
M3 requires no new cron entries or permanent daemon.
Existing deployment must retain its .env, APP_KEY, database and storage contents.
R1 replaces unsafe test database configuration in the original M3 package.
R1 has no new database migration.
Read docs/M3-R1-RECOVERY.md before recovery; code changes cannot recover deleted records.
R2 reduces exchange-list and spot pair catalogue memory use without raising the PHP memory limit.
R2 includes version-checked offline descriptions for all 110 adapters in the locked CCXT release.
R2 adds no migrations, dependency changes, scheduled tasks or permanent daemon.
Measured memory results use a synthetic response and are not a bound for arbitrary live responses.
R3 adds source-bound access reviews for all 110 locked adapters, Composer metadata refresh and daily 03:20 reconciliation through the existing cron.
Unknown/removed adapters are hidden; existing subscriptions are preserved and automatic collection is blocked pending review.
R3 does not implement subscriber credential collection.
R4 replaces the misleading candle-period dropdown with a read-only Automatic display and a separate expandable interval reference. No database, collector, CLI or scheduler changes.
R5 removes the candle-period form control and retains its explanation box. No database, collector, CLI or scheduler changes.

R6 adds private encrypted preferences, bounded explained pair suggestions and explicit review through the existing subscription form. One additive table migration; no new daemon, schedule or CLI command. Regional reviews default to unknown, and missing evidence remains exploratory.

R7 guards the optional suggestions link when any suggestion route is missing, tolerates missing optional prefill values during partial updates, and documents targeted route/view cache recovery. The full source retains all R6 routes. No new migration, dependency, command or schedule.

technical_alignment.implementation: FeatureEngine::calculateSlice invokes the ordinary array APIs; ticker_slide/ticker_slice retain calculated overlap and recursive boundary values. No alternative single-candle indicator recurrence API.
technical_alignment.normalization: normalize_ticker is called directly immediately after the sole production CCXT fetch_ohlcv call. Reindex=true means integer Unix seconds; original integer milliseconds remain in microtimestamp. Explicit milliseconds indexing is supported.
technical_alignment.precision: Normalized decimal strings never pass through float formatting. Shared technical recurrences use BCMath. Existing final ML/context values and tanh normalization remain floating-point.
technical_alignment.slice_validation: Batch sizes 1, 7, 48, 72 and 500, including EMA24, have strict decimal-string/all-row parity assertions. Cold raw tail reseeding and insufficient overlap fail visibly.
technical_alignment.indicators: EMA, SMA, SMMA, RSI, ATR/ATRP, Stochastic RSI, CCI, ROC, volume activity and candle geometry
additional_fixes: Timestamp-key compatibility for position-based Ichimoku/inflexion/slope access
Exact SMA working sum with published scale retained
Decimal/scientific input conversion without narrowing string values
technical_alignment.rebuild: Build new m2-v3 feature rows and datasets when needed; old versions and frozen datasets are not overwritten.
